Latin word

epistula

epistula, epistulae f.

noun, first declension

a letter, a written message sent to someone

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Q. Fr. 3.1.8: quās plūribus epistulīs accēpī (Lewis & Short); Traupman 339; Cic. Q. fr. 3.1.8 (Lewis & Short); Vulg. Col. 4.16

    modern
